name: knowledge-studio
description: Local-first desktop knowledge workspace built on plain Markdown files.

scripts.test:e2e: corepack pnpm build && playwright test --config playwright.electron.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:headed: corepack pnpm build && playwright test --config playwright.electron.config.ts --headed
scripts.package:win:unpacked: corepack pnpm package:stage && node scripts/package-audit.mjs stage && electron-builder --projectDir release/stage --config electron-builder.yml --win --x64 --dir
scripts.package:win:nsis: corepack pnpm package:win:unpacked && corepack pnpm package:smoke && electron-builder --projectDir release/stage --config electron-builder.yml --win --x64
